capabilities: Sync a vault between devices via cloud storage providers
Connect to S3-compatible, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive and other endpoints
Encrypt synced files end-to-end with a password
Run syncing manually, periodically, or on save
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. data.json holds provider credentials and should not be shared or committed. The plugin is free but providers may charge fees; deeper guides (debugging, performance, per-provider setup) live outside the README.
intentEvidence: an independent project based on the open-source Remotely Save codebase
problem: Obsidian users need a way to sync a vault across devices using their own cloud storage provider instead of relying on the official paid Sync service.

relations.evidence: an independent project based on the open-source Remotely Save codebase

requires.name: provider fees for storage or transfer

summary: Vault sync plugin that keeps notes in sync across devices through the user's own cloud storage such as S3, Dropbox, WebDAV, or Google Drive.
